servicesIntro: Regular upkeep, deep restoration and long-lasting protection, all with professional products used every day by the team.

services.name: Wash Plans
services.text: Weekly, biweekly or monthly washes to keep your boat clean and ready.

services.name: Full Detail with Wax
services.text: A full detail with wax protection, offered 2, 3 or 4 times a year.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Protection for 12 to 18 months, easier cleaning and more gloss.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Scratch and hologram removal, heavy oxidation removal, wet sanding, buffing and polishing.

services.name: Teak Maintenance
services.text: Teak cleaning and sealer application, best done 4 times a year.
